message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on an aluminum electrical cabinet. The candidate headings are 8537 (boards, panels, consoles, cabinets for electric control or distribution, equipped with apparatus), 8538 (parts suitable for use with 8535/8536/8537), 8536, and 7610 (aluminum structures).

The cabinet has a bus bar, a terminal block, and grounding cables, but the equipment is added after importation. It is an enclosure with minimal components. Heading 8538.90 covers parts of 8537 apparatus, and 8537.10 requires the cabinet to be equipped with apparatus. A bus bar and terminal block are not really switching apparatus, so 8537 is doubtful.

Alternatively, 8538.90 for parts, or 7610.90 for other aluminum structures. Enclosures for electrical apparatus are commonly classified in 8538.90 as parts. Because the cabinet is dedicated to housing electrical equipment, I believe the ruling classified it under 8538.90.8180 or similar. The 8538.90 subheadings are: 8538.90.20 (printed circuit assemblies), 8538.90.40 (for 8536.69...), 8538.90.60, 8538.90.81 (other: 8538.90.8160 and 8538.90.8180). I'll go with 8538.90.8180.
